name: The Beginning of the End
source:
As the Crooked Man's wizarding apprentice, your supernatural abilities have become unexplainable and increasingly dangerous.  You've been taken into custody by an organisation whose mission is to destroy dark Pandemonic threats...and they seem to think you might be one. Your mentor's secrets are beginning to unravel, and a new threat to your safety lurks in the shadows...The question is, can you keep your mentor and yourself safe from the danger that's closing in?

[From [url=https://seraten04.itch.io/the-beginning-of-the-end]itch.io[/url]]
